subject: Install a CRAN package for a learnr tutorial

messages.author: 1562416f5ac8e298
messages.subject: Install a CRAN package for a learnr tutorial
parts:
I'm trying to install one of my packages (JM), which is available on CRAN (https://cran.r-project.org/package=JM) for a learnr tutorial. In the beginning of the tutorial I have the code:

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library("learnr")
library("survival")
library("lattice")
library("JM")
data("aids.id", package = "JM")
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE)
```

This works of course fine in my machine, but when I try to deploy the tutorial on shinyapps.io the package does not seem to get installed and the tutorial does not work. Should I make the requirement for JM evident in some other way in order for rsconnect to pick it up?

Thanks in advance for any pointers!

Best,
Dimitris
